daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to think deeper than usual—your ruling planet wants real conversations, not surface-level chatter. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction is amplifying confidence, but that Sun-Mars square might create some friction between what you want to say and what actually comes out.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is keeping things balanced and fair in your connections. If you've been overthinking a relationship, today's energy encourages you to actually voice what's on your mind instead of running through scenarios in your head.
daily.career: The Moon trine Mars gives you momentum to push forward on projects, even if Saturn retrograde has you second-guessing yourself. This is a solid day to take action on something you've been planning—your instincts are sharp right now.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a bit wired with all this fire energy around. Ground yourself with movement or time outside. Mercury in Scorpio suggests paying attention to what your gut is telling you about what your body needs.
